## Review and release
- [ ] Other model reviewed the current head SHA; findings are recorded.
- [ ] No secrets or private school records included.
- [ ] Handoff/task record and relevant changelog updated.
- [ ] Receipt, manual/peer work and authority boundaries checked where relevant.
- [ ] Rollback and remaining risks stated.

Model review is advisory, especially when both agents share a GitHub identity. Merge is not deployment. Production requires the owner's release decision and the permitted deployment window.
